author: Liam O'Connor
title: Boylesports Sponsors West Ham United
text:
LONDON, June 19, 2025
West Ham’s Betting Sponsor Premier League club West Ham United has inked a one-year deal with Irish gambling provider Boylesports, starting in the 2025/2026 season .
Boylesports will be West Ham’s new main jersey sponsor for the 2025/2026 season. The deal is worth around £12 million. This sponsorship is possible due to a temporary exception before the gambling advertising ban.
The Gambling Sponsorship Landscape The recent partnership between West Ham United and BoyleSports highlights the evolving dynamics of sports sponsorships, especially within the Premier League.This deal, a one-year agreement for the 2025/2026 season [[1]] , is particularly engaging given the upcoming restrictions on gambling advertising.
The agreement will see BoyleSports replace Betway, who had been West Ham’s front-of-shirt sponsor for a decade [[2]] [[3]] . the financial terms are reportedly in the region of £12 million, offering a important injection of funds for the club [[3]] . Such a move underscores the high stakes involved in securing these lucrative partnerships, even during a period of regulatory transition.
Many Premier League clubs have historically relied on revenue from gambling companies. The incoming ban on gambling sponsors signals a change in the financial landscape for many football teams. This agreement exemplifies a last hurrah amid stricter regulations.
Why Now? The timing of this deal is crucial. The Premier League is set to implement a ban on gambling sponsors on the front of shirts. This means the BoyleSports deal is essentially a race against time – one last opportunity before the advertising ban fully kicks in [[1]] [[2]] . This change reflects growing concerns about the impact of gambling advertising on fans, particularly children.
The Impact on Clubs For West Ham, the BoyleSports partnership ensures a continued revenue stream. However, the club will need to seek alternative sponsors in the future. This shift requires careful financial planning and a proactive approach to brand partnerships.
What’s Next? The long-term implications of the gambling ad ban will unfold over the coming seasons. Clubs will likely explore options such as:
Partnering wiht non-gambling companies. Focusing on othre revenue streams like streaming and merchandise. Negotiating with sponsors of other categories. The Premier League’s ban on gambling sponsorships aims to address the rising concerns surrounding gambling and football. Clubs will have to adjust their financial models. The league has made a significant move and the coming seasons will show how effectively these teams can thrive.
Frequently Asked Questions 1. What does “front-of-shirt sponsorship” mean?
This refers to the primary sponsor whose logo appears prominently on the front of a team’s jersey.
2. Why are gambling sponsorships being banned?
the ban stems from concerns about the normalization of gambling and its potential impact on fans. Of particular focus are vulnerable groups, such as young people.
3. How will West Ham be affected by the ban?
While the BoyleSports deal provides a final year of sponsorship, the club will need to find new sources of revenue to replace the income from gambling sponsors after the 2025/2026 season.
4. Are other sports and leagues experiencing similar changes?
Yes, many sports are facing scrutiny regarding gambling partnerships. Various changes are underway in different leagues across the globe.
5. Will this ban affect betting on football games?
No, the sponsorship ban doesn’t directly impact the legality or availability of betting on football.It focuses on the advertising and promotion of gambling by football clubs.
